title: SREV-192 GUI COPYDATA wire length contract
contracts: GuiWire.h owns the local GUI_SEND_COPYDATA_REQ wire shape
COPYDATASTRUCT cbData is a byte count
COPYDATASTRUCT lpData is generic PVOID data, not a wide string
GUI_SEND_COPYDATA_REQ cds_buf is a byte tail
SendCopyDataSlave must prove the fixed request header through FIELD_OFFSET before reading cds_len
The enum request id GUI_SEND_COPYDATA is not a structure size owner
The service must prove FIELD_OFFSET plus cds_len fits inside req_len before using cds_buf
DLL senders must allocate FIELD_OFFSET plus byte payload length
runtime proof is required on Windows for normal WM_COPYDATA DDE copydata and malformed short request handling
runtime_gate: Windows SbieSvc and DLL build plus normal WM_COPYDATA DDE copydata short-header and short-tail malformed request proof
